# Community Metrics {#com-met}

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Define the CoP groups and their corresponding codes
cop_groups <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit",
  "Epi-Parameters",
  "epipipelines",
  "DTD_data-to-decision",
  "mpox",
  "DengueAnalytics",
  "InfluenzaEpiAA",
  "IOA",
  "IPSN",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools",
  "EIOS_Community",
  "PEIInnovationForum"
)

# Filter out "discobot" and "system"
filtered_users <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email")))

# Separate multiple groups per user into individual rows
cop_counts <- filtered_users %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%  # Split groups into multiple rows
  filter(group_names %in% cop_groups) %>%  # Keep only CoP groups
  count(group_names, name = "Member_Count") %>%  # Count members per CoP group
  arrange(desc(Member_Count))  # Sort by most members

# Select the top 5 CoP communities by membership count
top_5_cop <- cop_counts %>%
  top_n(5, wt = Member_Count) %>%
  arrange(desc(Member_Count))
```

#| warning: false

# Community Engagement Levels

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| include: false
# Step 1: Define CoPs of interest
cop_groups <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit", "Epi-Parameters", "epipipelines", "DTD_data-to-decision",
  "mpox", "DengueAnalytics", "InfluenzaEpiAA", "IOA", "IPSN",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools", "EIOS_Community", "PEIInnovationForum"
)

# Reusable function: returns engagement group per user
categorize_time_spent_per_user <- function(data, reference_date) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      months_active = as.numeric(difftime(reference_date, created_at, units = "days")) / 30,
      months_active = ifelse(months_active < 1, 1, months_active),
      time_read_per_month = time_read_min / months_active,
      engagement_group = case_when(
        time_read_per_month >= 15 ~ "Highly engaged (15+ min/month)",
        time_read_per_month >= 2 & time_read_per_month < 15 ~ "Moderately engaged (2-15 min/month)",
        time_read_per_month < 2 ~ "Barely engaged (under 2 min/month)",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(id, email, engagement_group)
}

user_engagement_data1 <- categorize_time_spent_per_user(data1, reference_date)

# Define CoP groups
cop_groups <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit", "Epi-Parameters", "epipipelines", "DTD_data-to-decision",
  "mpox", "DengueAnalytics", "InfluenzaEpiAA", "IOA", "IPSN",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools", "EIOS_Community", "PEIInnovationForum"
)

# Prepare CoP membership list
cop_membership <- data1 %>%
  filter(!(email %in% c("discobot_email", "no_email"))) %>%
  separate_rows(group_names, sep = ";") %>%
  filter(group_names != "", group_names %in% cop_groups) %>%
  select(id, email, group_names)

# Join with engagement labels
cop_engagement <- cop_membership %>%
  left_join(user_engagement_data1, by = c("id", "email")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(engagement_group))

# Group and calculate percentage breakdowns
cop_summary <- cop_engagement %>%
  group_by(group_names, engagement_group) %>%
  summarise(User_Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(group_names) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Users = sum(User_Count),
    Percentage = round(100 * User_Count / Total_Users, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(group_names, desc(engagement_group)) %>%
  rename(
    CoP = group_names,
    Engagement_Level = engagement_group
  )

# Result
cop_summary

# Step: Keep only the 3 labeled engagement groups
cop_summary_filtered <- cop_summary %>%
  filter(Engagement_Level %in% c(
    "Highly engaged (15+ min/month)",
    "Moderately engaged (2-15 min/month)",
    "Barely engaged (under 2 min/month)"
  ))

# Step: Pivot wider
cop_engagement_pivot <- cop_summary_filtered %>%
  select(CoP, Engagement_Level, Percentage) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Engagement_Level,
    values_from = Percentage,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Optional: Clean column names
colnames(cop_engagement_pivot) <- c(
  "CoP",
  "Highly engaged (%)",
  "Moderately engaged (%)",
  "Barely engaged (%)"
)

```

```{r}
#| fig-align: left
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| echo: false
cop_groups <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit",
  "Epi-Parameters",
  "epipipelines",
  "DTD_data-to-decision",
  "mpox",
  "DengueAnalytics",
  "InfluenzaEpiAA",
  "IOA",
  "IPSN",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools",
  "EIOS_Community",
  "PEIInnovationForum"
)

# Named vector for display names
cop_display_names <- c(
  "CollaboratorySummit" = "Collaboratory Summit",
  "Epi-Parameters" = "Epidemiological Parameters",
  "epipipelines" = "Epidemiological Pipelines",
  "DTD_data-to-decision" = "Data to Decision",
  "mpox" = "Mpox Analytics",
  "DengueAnalytics" = "Dengue and Other Arbovirus Analytics",
  "InfluenzaEpiAA" = "Influenza Epidemiology and Advanced Analytics",
  "IOA" = "Integrated Outbreak Analytics",
  "IPSN" = "International Pathogen Surveillance Network",
  "Surv_Outbreak_Tools" = "Surveillance and Outbreak Response Tools",
  "EIOS_Community" = "Epidemic Intelligence from Open Sources",
  "PEIInnovationForum" = "PEI Innovation Forum"
)

# ---- Prepare and filter group data ----
data1_groups <- data1 %>%
  select(id, group_names) %>%
  mutate(groups = str_split(group_names, ";")) %>%
  unnest(groups) %>%
  # remove trust_level_* groups and groups not in cop_groups
  filter(
    !str_starts(groups, "trust_level_"),
    groups %in% cop_groups
  ) %>%
  distinct(id, groups)

# ---- Compute shared membership edges safely ----
group_pairs <- data1_groups %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarize(
    group_pairings = if(length(unique(groups)) >= 2) {
      list(combn(sort(unique(groups)), 2, simplify = FALSE))
    } else {
      list(NULL)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  unnest(group_pairings) %>%
  filter(!is.null(group_pairings)) %>%
  mutate(
    from = map_chr(group_pairings, 1),
    to = map_chr(group_pairings, 2)
  ) %>%
  count(from, to, name = "shared_members")

# ---- Compute node sizes ----
node_sizes <- data1_groups %>%
  distinct(id, groups) %>%
  count(groups, name = "member_count")

# ---- Build graph ----
community_graph <- tbl_graph(edges = group_pairs, directed = FALSE)

community_graph <- community_graph %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  left_join(node_sizes, by = c("name" = "groups")) %>%
  mutate(
    member_count = replace_na(member_count, 1),
    display_name = coalesce(cop_display_names[name], name)
  )




# ---- Plot graph ----
ggraph(community_graph, layout = "fr") + 
  geom_edge_link(aes(width = shared_members), alpha = 0.4, color = "#051D4F") + 
  geom_node_point(aes(size = member_count), alpha = 0.8, color = "#F09F33") + 
  geom_node_text(aes(label = display_name), repel = TRUE, size = 4) + 
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 10)) + 
  theme_void() + 
  labs(size = "Group Size", width = "Shared Members", title = "Interconnections") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, family = "Lato", color = "#051D4F", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, face = "italic", family = "Lato", color = "#051D4F"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )


```
